capabilities: Create tasks via a guided modal
Configure multiple target notes for tasks
Append a configurable tag to created tasks
Set due dates using natural language input
Trigger task creation through the obsidian://create-task URI with prefilled parameters
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only creates tasks and leaves management to plugins like Tasks or CardBoard.
extras: README notes that Lazy Loader users must set Create Task to Instant or the URI will not open the modal when Obsidian is closed; includes setup examples for Raycast, Windows shortcuts, Chrome bookmarks, and Android's Automate.
intentEvidence: Create Task was made to improve the creation of tasks in Obsidian.
motivation: The author wanted tasks stored in different notes per project and tagged for CardBoard's tag-based columns, while other plugins save all tasks in a single note.
problem: Obsidian has plugins for managing tasks but nothing focused on quickly capturing a task into the right note with a tag and due date.

relations.evidence: This is helpful when using the CardBoard plugin since their columns are tag-based.
there are already many other plugins like CardBoard and Tasks

summary: Task-creation helper that opens a step-by-step modal from the command palette, ribbon, or obsidian:// URI to write tasks into configurable target notes.
